assets.purpose: Six original three-second looping scenes, one for each chapter other than automated driving, drawn live on a canvas (no image files) in that scene's night-time isometric treatment. Each has three labelled one-second beats: price (blank tag, calendar year, warranty dome), range (plug in, charge, range), space (seats, storage, safety), convenience (approach, unlock, ready), comfort (cool, warm, smooth) and software (update, phone, voice). They reuse the automated-driving scene's original code-built black Model Y; no Tesla media, logo or wordmark is used. Conceptual: no price, figure, rating or manufacturer interface is drawn, and nothing shown is evidence of any vehicle's equipment. Replaces the flat SVG chapter illustrations on the page; those stay available via the `scene` flag in src/lib/chapter-art.ts.
